safety_and_scope: All counts are small and nonnegative. Invalid total0/prefix0/prefix>total are rejected by399e60 validation before allocation.
Every direct face uses indices1,2,3 of a complete nondegenerate three-vertex coordinate set. No partial direct connectivity or coordinate rows.
Planar retained segments remain format2 throughout files8..14; successful format2 reconversion never reaches narrow format1 storage. File15 destroys planar objects before spatial cases.
File24 spatial alternate pre-clear removes the prior empty format0 segment before format2 conversion.
Finite values only; exponents are small. No floating range boundary, nonfinite literal, integer overflow, negative allocation extent or OOM injection.
OBJTYP selector,type,secondary share one physical line in files1,3,4,5. No accidental blank integer-pair header.
Signed-zero raw bits and exponent/sign/suffix consumption are observations to compare, without decimal-only tolerance assumptions.
No original process launch by fixture author. Freeze must bind the existing candidate and these independent fixture/probe bytes before evaluation.
outcomes_not_assumed: Helper failures and wrapper/import statuses are distinct. Unknown trailing tokens may be skipped by the outer parser; compare event/cursor ordering.
Normal finalization may reconstruct direct plane-list addresses; compare semantic values and raw numeric fields, not allocator identities.
No full application's GUI, other geometry containers or downstream transform semantics are asserted.
